terms.title: Terms & Conditions

article1.title: 1. Purpose
article1.text: These general terms govern the use of vehicle rental services offered by Kriagadir, a company based in Agadir, Morocco.

article2.title: 2. Booking and confirmation
article2.text: Any booking is final after submitting the online form. A confirmation email will be sent to you.

article3.title: 3. Prices and payment
article3.text: Prices shown are per day, excluding additional insurance. Payment is made upon key handover, in cash or by credit card.

article4.title: 4. Cancellation
article4.text: Any cancellation must be reported at least 48 hours before the pickup date. Beyond this period, the deposit may be withheld.

article5.title: 5. Liability
article5.text: The driver is responsible for any damage caused to the vehicle during the rental period. Civil liability insurance is included.

article6.title: 6. Disputes
article6.text: Any dispute shall be submitted to the competent courts of Agadir, Morocco.

terms.contact: For any questions, contact us at contact@kriagadir.ma or +212 600 144 245.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy

section1.title: Information collection
section1.text: We collect information you directly provide when booking: first name, last name, email, phone number, and pickup location.

section2.title: Use of data
section2.text: Your data is used only to process your reservation, contact you, and improve our services. It is never sold to third parties.

section3.title: Security
section3.text: We implement technical and organisational measures to protect your data from unauthorised access.

section4.title: Cookies
section4.text: Our site uses cookies to improve your experience. You can disable them in your browser settings.

section5.title: Your rights
section5.text: In accordance with the law, you have the right to access, rectify, and delete your personal data.

privacy.contact: To exercise your rights, write to dpo@kriagadir.ma
